text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down sharply over 24 hours, with Ethereum's 4.2% decline outpacing Bitcoin's 2.8% drop, suggesting weakened conviction in the broader crypto narrative. The Fear & Greed index at 29 reflects genuine apprehension, though the 4-point weekly gain hints that the sell-off may be stabilizing rather than accelerating. Elevated Bitcoin dominance at 56.4% paired with $67B in daily volume indicates money is rotating toward perceived safety rather than fleeing crypto entirely.
